picks.what: The city across the Tigris, wood engraving in Le Tour du monde
picks.why: detailed riverfront skyline with domes and minarets, including the tall minaret of the Great Mosque

gaps: P0–P3, P5: nothing; P6: no usable photo of the city
notes: #2 is engraved after Flandin’s 1840s drawing; dated 1861, its first publication. #1 (Badger, The Nestorians and their Rituals, 1852, drawn 1842–43) is a wider but faint panorama with the boat bridge; a fair P4 alternative, but too close to 1861 for a second P4 slot. P6: #3 is the Mosul Dam reservoir, not the city; #4 a hazy view of the Mar Gorgis monastery in a suburb; #5 a collage.
